messages:
Priya (CS): Quick ask  we need a 30m 'snackable' office hours for customer Aurora next Tue to cover onboarding gaps + a short renewal health check. Proposed window: Tue 11:0011:30 PT. Can folks volunteer to lead and take notes?

Lena: I can lead. I'll do a 10-min checklist walkthrough and 5-min troubleshooting patterns. Prefer we keep a strict timer.

Omar: I can cover integrations questions and check the migration ticket list. Will need the customer to confirm which integration (GCS vs S3) is in scope.

Aisha: Ill prepare a one-slide renewal snapshot (usage trend + support cases + CSAT). I can also surface renewal flags and a recommended next step.

Priya (CS): Great  can @onboarding-bot create the calendar event with the mini-agenda and set a 24h pre-read reminder? Also we should ask the customer for a short pre-call checklist: confirm integration type + current error rate.

onboarding-bot: Created event -> https://cal.example.com/event/1716945600. Agenda skeleton attached to the event and doc: https://redwood.docs/snackable-office-hours-template.ics. Reminder set for 24h pre-event.

Lena: Proposed run order (tight):
```
- 0:00 roll call & purpose (2m)
- 0:02 onboarding checklist highlight (10m)
- 0:12 integration Qs (7m)
- 0:19 renewal health + quick mitigations (6m)
- 0:25 actions, owners & next steps (5m)
```

Omar: I'll add a short troubleshooting snippet to the doc, including the quick commands we usually share: `rtr --logs 5m --tail` and the mini-debug checklist. Also can someone confirm timezone for the customer contact (they're CET). If so, 11am PT = 8pm CET which is late.

Priya (CS): Good catch  customer is CET. We should offer two slots: 8am PT (4pm CET) or 11am PT (8pm CET). Preference from Aurora? I'll ping them now.

Aisha: If they prefer earlier, I can switch but need 24h to adjust slides. Also will include a 2-bullet pre-read: current top blocker + what we'd like them to confirm.

Priya (CS): Customer replied: prefers earlier slot. Let's move to 8:008:30 PT. @onboarding-bot can you update the event and nudge the team?

onboarding-bot: Event updated -> https://cal.example.com/event/1716945600 (start changed to 1716924000). Reminder rule kept. Notification ping posted to participants.

Lena: Updated my calendar. I'll keep the demo to a 2-min clip and focus on must-fix items.

Omar: I'll prepare the integration question list and mark tickets by priority. I'll also run a pre-call perf check 15m before and post results here.

Priya (CS): Notes owner? Need someone to capture action items and push them to our tracker after the call.

Aisha: I can capture notes and publish the 1-slide renewal snapshot post-call. I'll add a short survey link for feedback: https://redwood.survey/aurora-enable-quick. 2 questions max.

Lena: Thanks  I'll add time stamps in the doc so Aisha can clip the section for the follow-up.

Priya (CS): Summary of deliverables: 1) onboarding-bot: event + agenda + reminder (done/updated). 2) Lena: checklist + 2-min demo clip (due day before). 3) Omar: integration Qs + perf check 15m prior. 4) Aisha: renewal snapshot + notes + post-call survey publish. 5) Priya: ping customer pre-read now. Please flag if you cannot make the new time. Meeting link will be the updated calendar event. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
